notes.title: Spire Horizon Online Christmas Update
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas Everyone

Here’s what’s included in this update:
- Stop fishing automatically when the inventory is full.  
- Reduce experience gained from bosses.  
- Introduce two new event bosses.  
- Add a new event: "Merry Christmas" 25 December 2024 to 10 January 2025.  
- Make all quest items sellable (note: quest items are limited and can only be obtained from quests).  
- Add a new title for players who purchase a dragon egg: "Dragon Master".  
- Add a new title: "Merry Christmas".  
- Add a new title: "Giant Slayer".  
- Balance drop/crafting equipment/weapon substats based on quality:  
  - Common: 1 substat  
  - Uncommon: 2 substats  
  - Rare: 3 substats  
  - Epic: 4 substats  
  - Legendary: 5 substats  
- Reduce the price of monster stones from 300,000 gold to 35,000 gold.

notes.title: Spire Horizon Online Optimize Patch (1.0.2)
notes.notes:
Spire Horizon Online Optimize Patch (1.0.2)

- Reduce game size from 22GB to 13GB.
- Optimize graphics.
- Optimize GPU RAM usage.
- Optimize overall FPS in-game.
- Fix boss/monster getting stuck.
- Fix food icon not showing.
- Increase player icon size in worldmap.
- Helmets from quest are now sellable.
- Normal monsters will no longer drop items. Items will instead be added directly to the player's inventory to prevent snatching by other players.
- Items will no longer auto-sort after bulk selling.
- Potions are now usable with a Thai keyboard.
- Change the marketplace minimum price from 50 to 10.
- Upgrading wings now requires wing to upgrade from 2 to 3.
- New currency: "Mystic Shard."
- Fashion and wings can now be sold to obtain Mystic Shards. (I do not recommend selling now, as duplicate mounts, pets, and wings can be upgraded further in the future.)
- Fix quest titles and descriptions that are incorrect.
- Fix the item reward for the quest "The Slithering Shadow of the Clearing."
- Fix floating bait on the map.
- Fix Luminy and Skarknot not dealing damage.
- Fix Assassin not being able to deal damage to the Crystal.
- Players can now select which potion to use.
- Items can now be easily transferred from the player's inventory to storage by right-clicking on the item.
- Bulk selling now allows players to exclude items they don't want to sell.
- Add item tooltips in the bulk sell menu.
- Players can now see their health bar, level, and name. This can be toggled on or off in Settings > General > Hide Player Info.
- Add a new Player Title System, which can be accessed under the Change Name button.
- Add a special Player Title for Kofi Supporters.
- Temporarily disable the sorting system while improvements are being made.
